answers.question: Find the number of orchestras whose record format is "CD" or "DVD".
answers.generated_answer: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orchestra WHERE major_record_format LIKE '%CD%' OR major_record_format LIKE '%DVD%'

answers.question: Show the years in which orchestras that have given more than one performance are founded.
answers.generated_answer: select year_of_founded from orchestra where orchestra_id in (select performance_id from performance group by performance_id) group by year_of_founded

answers.question: What are years of founding for orchestras that have had more than a single performance?
answers.generated_answer: SELECT year_of_founded FROM orchestra WHERE orchestra_id IN (SELECT orchestra_id FROM performance GROUP BY orchestra_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
